name: What can go wrong when removing an old bathtub?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong when removing an old bathtub?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are damage to surrounding tile, drywall, flooring, and plumbing if the tub is removed without the right tools or experience. Cast-iron tubs are especially risky because they are heavy and often need to be cut apart or broken up carefully.
acceptedAnswer.description: The main risks are damage to tile, floors, and plumbing. Heavy tubs and tight bathrooms make DIY removal especially risky.
